name: Memories Frozen in Time
source:
A jaded college student rummages through his hold closet in his hometown and finds a series of photographs involving him and his childhood best friend, sending him down memory lane.

[From [url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/mfit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名疲惫不堪的大学生翻遍了家乡的储物柜，发现了一系列他和儿时最好的朋友的照片，勾起了他的回忆。

[来自[url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/mfit]Itch.io[/url]]
